name: fighter_load_character_record
comment: Copies 0x34 words of the record to fighter +0x70 and sets up the working arrays; returns 1 on asset failure.

name: fighter_load_character
comment: Requires the shared 2cmnbod1 and body providers; resolves animation names (cmn names in the shared provider), leaving slots 0x48..0x4F empty.

name: character_dispatch_channel
comment: Events 1,2,3,5,6 -> callback slots 0,1,2,4,5; major 8 actions 0..3 use the configured jutsu owner's callbacks (selectors +0x154/+0x156). NA2 counterpart 0x00217670.

name: hit_select_response
comment: Defender response from action +0x28 selector (0x27..0x51); the source owner's callback slot 3 can override it.

name: doto_create
comment: Allocates 0x1AB0 bytes and calls doto_construct.

name: doto_construct
comment: Base constructor, vtable 0x005BBF70, working animation array fighter +0xAF0 (record +0x40), working actions +0xD44 (record +0x30), then fighter_load_character_record.

name: doto_channel3
comment: Event-3 callback: per-action phase/frame steps for actions 8, 13, 14, 15, 17, 36..38 (sounds 0x28/0x2F, forward motion, ground-code footstep sound and dust).

name: doto_response_override
comment: Slot 3: overrides the defender response for actions 8, 10, 13, 14 by hit count and airborne state; -1 keeps the default.

name: doto_capture_pin
comment: Event-5 callback: during throw actions 16/17 on the same stage section, sets the held opponent's position from a node matrix.

name: jutsu_animation_archive_name
comment: Word 0 of jutsu_animation_provider_table row [selector].

name: jutsu_selector_character
comment: Positive selector >> 1, else 0 (US 0x001ED4C0).

name: audio_request_archive_member
comment: (bank, member, slot, family): checks the bank bound and the descriptor's member count (+6) in audio_archive_descriptor_lists[family].

name: audio_load_character_bank
comment: Loads SNDDATA.BIN rows of audio_character_banks[index] (RPC 0x9400) and binds side bank 0x9056 + side.

name: audio_write_pending_stream
comment: Pending stream row [slot]: bank = character - 1, member, slot, alternate family, pending 1. One PLVOICE bank per character (no language set).

name: sp_skill_part_frame
comment: Frame callback: runs frame-script ops 1/2/3 by frame, and moves the defender to the offset triple of the current threshold (block +0 count, +4 halfword thresholds, +8 per-defender-ID triple lists).

name: sp_skill_part_begin
comment: Begin callback of each cinematic part: binds participant eye/mouth palettes, frame script from jutsu_cinematic_frame_scripts, contest duration from jutsu_contest_rows (shifted up to +-30 by the fighters' HP difference) into jutsu_contest_begin, and the part's defender-offset block from jutsu_cinematic_offsets.

name: sp_skill_build_requests
comment: Request list: row resident path (flag 0x1000), row extras (0x1000), then the row's part paths (first 0x400, others 0).

name: sp_skill_play_start
comment: Starts 'SP Skill Play' for attacker/defender characters and level (param 7 low half) and optional single part (high half): row from jutsu_cinematic_row_index, requests from sp_skill_build_requests, per-part offsets from jutsu_cinematic_offsets.

name: audio_setup_battle_banks
comment: Loads both fighters' compact banks with index = character - 1 (manager +0x42/+0x43).

name: audio_consume_pending_streams
comment: For each pending row: stop the slot, then audio_request_archive_member(bank, member, slot, family 3 PLVOICE) or the alternate family 0.

name: audio_skill_soundtrack_frame_update
comment: Starts each later part's STREAM.AFS member at its frame 1 and emits matching cue rows, as the US routine.

name: jutsu_contest_begin
comment: Sets both players' contest inputs from the part's contest row descriptors and the duration.

name: jutsu_presentation_update
comment: Ultimate Jutsu presentation states 1..5; state 2 at count 20 calls sp_skill_play_start with level = selector - 13.

name: doto_callbacks
comment: Slots: 1 empty stub, 2 doto_channel3, 3 doto_response_override, 4 doto_capture_pin.

name: doto_animation_names
comment: 149 ANM_pdtu* names; slots 0x48..0x4F reserved for jutsu animations (75 ANM_pdtucha00, 79 ANM_pdtucha10).

name: doto_actions
comment: 39 UN2 0x58-byte action records PL26_ATK_*; +0x50 points to each action's own phase rows, +0x54 jutsu selector.

name: doto_character_record
comment: ID 26, ドトウ, 2dtubod1.ccs; 0xD0-byte UN2 record: +0x1C callbacks, +0x28 action count 39, +0x2C actions, +0x38 animation count 149, +0x3C names; no 0x4C row table.

name: doto_character_descriptor
comment: Points back to doto_character_record; passed to fighter_load_character_record by doto_construct.

name: jutsu_null_action_pair
comment: Zero word, then a pointer to the null action record 0x00372A70; immediately precedes jutsu_animation_provider_table.

name: jutsu_animation_provider_table
comment: 68 rows of 12 bytes, filename at +0; selectors 52/53 = 2dtucha0/1.ccs (owner 26). Same layout as US 0x0040F898.

name: character_definition_table
comment: 34 (factory, record) pairs for IDs 0..33; ID 26 is Doto.

name: sp_skill_cue_descriptors
comment: Per jutsu_cinematic_rows row {12-byte cue rows, second pointer}, as the US table.

name: sp_skill_part_soundtracks
comment: Pointer per jutsu_cinematic_rows row to four halfwords: STREAM.AFS member of each part (-1 none).

name: audio_character_banks
comment: 12-byte rows (SNDDATA offset, header bytes, sample bytes) by character - 1; Doto row 25: 0xB2E000, 0x1240, 0x6A9C0.

name: audio_plvoice_descriptors
comment: 33 eight-byte descriptors (handle 0x32 + outer index, member count +6), then 0xFF sentinel; outer index = character - 1, Doto 25 (133 members).

name: audio_archive_descriptor_lists
comment: Per-family descriptor list pointers; family 3 = audio_plvoice_descriptors.

name: jutsu_cinematic_frame_scripts
comment: Word [char*3 + level]: per-part frame-script pointers; zero for Doto.

name: jutsu_cinematic_offsets
comment: Word [char*3 + level]: pointer to the per-part defender-offset block pointers for that cinematic.

name: character_select_model_filenames
comment: cs???.ccs list in select order plus extra entries; csdtu.ccs at 0x004E2FC0.

name: jutsu_cinematic_row_index
comment: unsigned short [char*3 + level]: row of jutsu_cinematic_rows; Doto 75/76/77.

name: character_select_order
comment: Entry 0 then Character Select's 33 IDs in grid order; Doto 26 is entry 28. US SLUS 0x004F1D10 drops 26 (32 IDs).

name: jutsu_cinematic_rows
comment: 0x14-byte rows: title, resident str/dNN_Le.ccs, extra count byte +8, part count byte +9, extras list +0xC, parts list +0x10 (title, path pairs).

name: jutsu_stage_damage
comment: Bytes [ID*15 + level*5 + stage]: four stage percents and a bonus percent.

name: jutsu_contest_rows
comment: 12-byte rows [char*0x90 + level*0x30 + part*0xC]: attacker and defender contest descriptors, s16 duration at +8, byte +10. Doto: descriptor 0x00597198 both sides, duration 90, byte +10 40 only on level 2 part 2.

name: jutsu_contest_modes
comment: Contest mode byte per ID*3 + level.
